_note: Curated (hand-verified against swain.bin.json). All four calc/type picks matched the auto-picker and resolve cleanly. Q (Death's Hand) 'InitialDamage' = BaseDamage + 0.45 AP, Magic -- models the guaranteed FIRST bolt; the BIN also has 'ExtraBoltDamage' (InitialDamage x0.25, additional bolts converging on the same target) and 'MaxDamage' (InitialDamage x2.0, the point-blank all-bolts tooltip max) but real bolt convergence on one target depends on cast-time relative positioning this project doesn't track, so only the single guaranteed bolt is modeled (P2). W (Vision of Empire) 'TotalDamage' = BaseDamage + 0.6 AP, Magic (delayed reveal+damage; a separate Vulnerable-debuff mechanic on low-health targets exists but is not itself extra damage). E (Nevermove) 'SecondaryDamage' = E2Damage + 0.7 AP, Magic -- the tendril itself has no direct-impact calc in the BIN; damage only fires from the delayed root-explosion, which is what this calc represents. R (Demonic Ascension) 'DamageCalc' = DamagePerSecond + 0.04 AP, Magic, curated as ONE second of the channeled drain (same per-second convention as Singed Q); tagged Zone since it is a persistent AoE around Swain that only damages enemies who stay in range. R's 'Demonflare' empowered-recast mechanic (DemonflareDamageTotal, up to 650 + 0.4 AP) is NOT modeled -- it requires tracking Swain's Demon Power resource (DemonPowerMax/Degen/Regen) and which of Q/W/E the player chooses to empower, neither of which this engine has a live feed for.
